title: Read native SpecSync spec files under specs at any size: Chough's 65536-byte structured-record bound no longer applies to spec companions such as requirements.md, every Chough record keeps its bound, and the workflow skill gains advisory composability guidance
description: Read native SpecSync spec files under specs at any size: Chough's 65536-byte structured-record bound no longer applies to spec companions such as requirements.md, every Chough record keeps its bound, and the workflow skill gains advisory composability guidance
acceptance_criteria: Chough reads a native SpecSync spec file under specs/ at any size: `chough evidence add` validates a requirement ID against a requirements.md companion larger than 4 MiB, and still refuses an ID owned by another module with the same message
Every Chough record keeps its bound: a structured record other than the checkpoint over 65,536 bytes and a checkpoint over 131,072 bytes are still refused, and RECORD_LIMIT stays 65,536

The workflow skill build reference gains advisory composability guidance, identical in the bundled and installed copies: split independent behavior, keep coupled behavior together, treat a source file nearing about 1,000 lines as a split candidate, and treat size as a hint, never a gate
`chough skill status` reports main's previous build reference as known-outdated, so `chough skill update` can refresh it
fmt, lint, the full tests, the new case and fledge lanes run verify pass

answers.constraints: AGENTS.md: preserve existing files and records and never invent results. REQ-cli-032 keeps every structured record other than the checkpoint at its existing bound; this change adds a separate requirement for native spec files and does not reword REQ-cli-032. Leif (0xLeif) 2026-11-03 10:05 AM MT: spec files can grow to any size, and composability guidance should keep things lean without being crazy about it. Existing archives stay untouched; SpecSync is unchanged; the 65,536-byte cap is Chough's own (SpecSync only bounds coverage files at 8 MiB).
